walkthrough:
Step 1: Set up the normal model:
Let $T$ be the time taken by Obi in minutes.
$$T \sim N(14.8, 1.3^2)$$
Mean $\mu = 14.8$, standard deviation $\sigma = 1.3$.

Step 3: Evaluate upper-tail probability:
$$\mathrm{P}(T > 15.6) = 1 - \Phi(0.615)$$
From standard normal tables: $\Phi(0.615) = 0.7307$.
$$1 - 0.7307 = 0.2693$$
Rounding to 3 significant figures gives $0.269$.

hints: Condition: P(T > t) = 0.90, which means P(T < t) = 0.10.
Since 0.10 < 0.5, the z-score is negative: look up 0.90 in normal tables, giving z = -1.282.
walkthrough:
Step 1: Interpret the given condition:
$$\mathrm{P}(T > t) = 0.90$$
By the complement rule:
$$\mathrm{P}(T < t) = 1 - 0.90 = 0.10$$

Step 2: Find the critical z-value:
Because $0.10 < 0.5$, $t$ lies below the mean, and the z-value is negative.
$$\Phi(-z) = 0.90$$
From the standard normal percentage points table: $\Phi(1.282) = 0.9000 \implies z = -1.282$.

Step 3: Standardise and solve for $t$:
$$\frac{t - 14.8}{1.3} = -1.282$$
$$t - 14.8 = -1.282 \times 1.3 = -1.6666$$
$$t = 14.8 - 1.6666 = 13.1334$$
Rounding to 3 significant figures gives $t = 13.1$ minutes.

Step 1: Define the interval within one minute of the mean:
Mean $\mu = 14.8$, standard deviation $\sigma = 1.3$.
$$14.8 - 1 < T < 14.8 + 1 \implies 13.8 < T < 15.8$$

Step 3: Evaluate probability using standard normal tables:
$$\mathrm{P}(-0.769 < Z < 0.769) = 2\Phi(0.769) - 1$$
From normal tables: $\Phi(0.769) = 0.7791$.
$$2(0.7791) - 1 = 1.5582 - 1 = 0.5582$$

Step 4: Compute expected days in a 365-day year:
$$\text{Expected days} = 365 \times 0.5582 = 203.743$$
Rounding to the nearest whole day gives $204$ days (or $203$ days).
